# Book designs — vector recreations of the physical seforim

*Generated by `npm run docs:designs` from `src/art/designs/*.ts`. Do not edit by hand.*

Every cover, spine and back is **drawn from scratch as SVG** (millimetre geometry, real Hebrew fonts, SVG-filter materials) and rasterised on demand for the 3D books at the resolution the quality tier needs. The photographs the user supplied were used only as measuring blueprints: no photograph is shipped, pasted, cropped or wrapped onto any book (`tests/art.test.ts` enforces: no `<image>`, no bitmap data, nothing in `public/books`).

The Kehot publisher mark is a vector trace (`scripts/trace-kehot.py`) of the logo file the user supplied; the other ornaments are redrawn by eye.

Side-by-side comparisons of each recreation against its blueprint are in `docs/screenshots/lab-*.png`; presented in 3D: `docs/screenshots/covers-sheet.png`.

## תורת מנחם — התוועדויות (Kehot / Vaad Hanachos), black cloth with gold bands

* Design id: `tm-hisvaaduyos` · volumes using it: 3
* Blueprint: assets-src/books/tm-hisvaaduyos.jpg (front volume cover + neighbouring spines)
* Size used (h×w×t cm): 24.5×17.5×3.2
* Binding / edge colours: `#2c2923` / `#efe6d2`

**Could not be established from the reference (approximated — verify against the physical book):**

* Title lettering is Miriam Libre Bold standing in for the publisher's custom block face (letter shapes approximate, placement and size measured).
* The grey side-strip motif is simplified (small framed squares); the real pattern is a finer woven/embossed design.
* Kehot mark: vector trace of the logo file supplied by the user (monochrome, foil-stamped); on the real books it is a small stamp whose fine lettering is below what the photos resolve, so its exact size and position are estimates.
* The photographed volume is תשמ״ב; the year line shows ה׳שי״ת / ה׳תשי״א as requested. The size, thickness and the spine's lower text lines for 5710/5711 are not verified.
* The spine carries no volume number (removed at the user’s request).

## לקוטי שיחות (Kehot) — navy cloth, wavy silver frame

* Design id: `ls-kehot` · volumes using it: 5
* Blueprint: assets-src/books/ls-vol25.jpg (vol. 25 Bereishis, photographed flat)
* Size used (h×w×t cm): 24×17×2.8
* Binding / edge colours: `#1d2b4e` / `#f3ecd9`

**Could not be established from the reference (approximated — verify against the physical book):**

* Title is Frank Ruhl Libre Medium; the publisher's face for "לקוטי שיחות" looks similar but was not identified.
* Wave size and spacing of the scalloped frame, and its exact distance from the edge, were measured from a low-resolution photo (±1 mm).
* Kehot mark: vector trace of the logo file supplied by the user (monochrome, foil-stamped); on the real books it is a small stamp whose fine lettering is below what the photos resolve, so its exact size and position are estimates.
* Volume lettering shows the volume letter without punctuation (י, יא …) as in the photographed "כה"; whether vol. 10–14 print it that way was not verified.
* Height 24 cm, width 17 cm and the 2.8 cm spine are estimates (the photo is a flat lay with a ruler of unreadable scale).

## תורת מנחם — ספר המאמרים, crocodile-grain leatherette with gold block lettering

* Design id: `tm-maamarim` · volumes using it: 1
* Blueprint: assets-src/books/tm-maamarim.jpg (the photographed volume reads תשמ״א; recreated with תשי״א as requested)
* Size used (h×w×t cm): 24×17×3
* Binding / edge colours: `#2f2a2d` / `#efe6d2`

**Could not be established from the reference (approximated — verify against the physical book):**

* Crocodile scale pattern is generated (random but seeded); the exact scale layout of the real binding is not reproduced.
* The blind-embossed frame and the top flourishes are simplified; the real ornament is more elaborate and was not legible enough in the photo to copy.
* Lettering is Miriam Libre Bold standing in for the publisher's block face; positions and sizes were measured.
* The spine label panel (flat black) and the positions of its gold bands were read from a foreshortened photo (±3 mm).
* Kehot mark traced from the user-supplied logo (size/position estimated). Thickness 3.0 cm and 17×24 cm size are estimates.

## ספר חת״ת (חומש · תהלים · תניא · סדור תהלת ה׳ · היום יום) — maroon leatherette, gold frame

* Design id: `chitas` · volumes using it: 1
* Blueprint: assets-src/books/chitas.jpg (seller photo, three-quarter view)
* Size used (h×w×t cm): 23×16×6
* Binding / edge colours: `#66232a` / `#f1e6c8`

**Could not be established from the reference (approximated — verify against the physical book):**

* The giant ח ת ת and the red words are set in stand-in typefaces (Suez One and Miriam Libre); the originals are custom decorative letters. Positions, sizes and colours were measured, glyph shapes are approximate.
* Corner scrolls and the rosette are redrawn from a ~1 mm-accurate reading of a small photo; the exact curl geometry is simplified.
* The spine text block is a scaled copy of the cover block; the real spine may break the words differently.
* The emblem at the foot of the spine is drawn as the Kehot mark (traced from the logo the user supplied); the photo is too small to confirm it is that emblem, and its size/position are estimated.
* Printed size (16 × 23 cm), the thick 6 cm spine and the rounded corners are estimated.
* Whether the back cover carries any ornament is unknown (shown plain).

## תלמוד בבלי · עוז והדר · מהדורת פריעדמאן — maroon leatherette, gold title, black spine panels

* Design id: `shas-ozvehadar` · volumes using it: 30
* Blueprint: assets-src/books/shas.jpg (seller photo, front + spine)
* Size used (h×w×t cm): 29×20.5×4, 29×20.5×6.075, 29×20.5×4.45, 29×20.5×4.95, 29×20.5×4.16875, 29×20.5×4.98125, 29×20.5×4.66875, 29×20.5×4.0125, 29×20.5×4.73125, 29×20.5×4.8875, 29×20.5×6.2, 29×20.5×4.7, 29×20.5×4.91875, 29×20.5×4.60625, 29×20.5×5.60625
* Binding / edge colours: `#4a1017` / `#eadfbf`

**Could not be established from the reference (approximated — verify against the physical book):**

* The title lettering is set in Miriam Libre Bold as a stand-in; the original is a custom tapered face with a dark keyline. Size, position and width were measured.
* The wording "מהדורת פריעדמאן" (spelled with an ע, as printed) follows the photo and a second sharper product photo of the same edition; it is the printed spelling of "Friedman", not a typo.
* The blind-embossed floral band and arched panel are drawn as simplified arabesques; the photo is too dark to read the original pattern.
* The cartouche scallop geometry is approximated by eye.
* The Oz VeHadar publisher mark at the foot of the spine is a placeholder (open-book icon in a square), not the real logo.
* The masechta name in the lower black spine panel is this app’s addition so volumes can be told apart; the photographed volume shows that panel empty.
* Cover 20.5 × 29 cm and spine thickness (4.0–6.2 cm by masechta size) are estimates.
* Edge colour of the page block is not visible in the photo (cream assumed).

## משנה תורה (הרמב״ם) — cream cloth, dark panel, outlined title

* Design id: `rambam` · volumes using it: 14
* Blueprint: assets-src/books/rambam.jpg (seller photo, cover + blurred spine)
* Size used (h×w×t cm): 24×16.5×3.4, 24×16.5×3, 24×16.5×4, 24×16.5×2.6, 24×16.5×3.2, 24×16.5×2.4, 24×16.5×3.8, 24×16.5×4.2, 24×16.5×2.8
* Binding / edge colours: `#ddd0aa` / `#efe6c8`

**Could not be established from the reference (approximated — verify against the physical book):**

* The photographed cover is cropped at the top and bottom; whether the dark panel stops short of the head and tail (a cream margin) is unknown. The panel is drawn full height.
* The cover title is a vector trace of the printed angular outline lettering (scripts/trace-art.py); outline weight is slightly irregular, as on the photo. The spine lettering uses a stand-in font.
* The spine photo is too blurred to read: the dark label panels, rules and positions are inferred from its light/dark pattern, and the spine lettering "משנה תורה" is a guess in the same stand-in face.
* The per-volume "ספר X" label panel at the foot of the spine is this app’s addition so the 14 volumes can be told apart; the photographed spine shows some unreadable text there.
* Cloth colours (cream #ddd0aa, brown #2a2321) are taken from the photo and may be shifted by its lighting.
* Size 24 × 16.5 cm and per-volume thickness (2.4–4.2 cm) are estimates.

## פירוש הרמב״ן על התורה — dark maroon leather, gold ornamental frame, oval medallion

* Design id: `ramban` · volumes using it: 5
* Blueprint: assets-src/books/ramban.jpg (seller photo, front + blurred spine)
* Size used (h×w×t cm): 25.5×17.5×3.8, 25.5×17.5×3.2, 25.5×17.5×3.4, 25.5×17.5×3.6
* Binding / edge colours: `#3a1e1f` / `#e6d9b4`

**Could not be established from the reference (approximated — verify against the physical book):**

* The corner acanthus scrolls, the ribbed border strips and the wreath around the medallion are redrawn as simplified ornaments; the photo shows rich engraved detail that cannot be read exactly.
* The title "הרמב״ן" is set in Suez One, "פירוש" and "על התורה" in Frank Ruhl Libre as stand-ins for the original engraved lettering. Positions and widths were measured.
* The spine photo is blurred: the gold band positions are measured, but the spine text lines and the crown ornament are inferred and simplified.
* The per-volume sefer name (בראשית…דברים) on the spine is this app’s addition so the five volumes can be told apart.
* The foot-of-spine emblem is a plain rosette placeholder; the photographed spine shows an emblem there that is unreadable.
* The edition’s printed size (25.5 × 17.5 cm) and thickness are estimates; the medallion fill is a near-black navy sampled from the photo.
